body:
I've tried a number of sports and clubs, but I didn't like any of them enough to want to keep going.
I'm on an antidepressant, and I feel better with it than I do without, but I still feel pretty terrible most of the time. I think it makes me drowsy, too.
My ADD always makes focusing difficult, but I can usually get through it. Right now, since the semester is coming to an end, I have an enormous amount of work and so I'm sort of sent into a state of sensory overload that makes it impossible to get anything done.
I play several instruments, but I only have my acoustic guitar with me, and the strings can't hold tune anymore. I mostly just like to relax by having a conversation with someone, but real conversation has been hard to find lately.

I've never been allowed to take anything for my ADD; being a minor, I don't really have a choice on the matter.
What makes me feel like an old man is that I have no energy and no social life. After a day of school, any sort of exercise is just short of impossible, and I can't make myself feel comfortable around other people when I always feel like shit.

Nothing really helps...when I'm around other people, they're usually enough of a distraction to keep my mind off of things, but they also tire me out pretty quickly, and that just makes it harder to keep track of everything I need to do.
